_rebuild: 2026-10-09 rerender of f-talk (dossie-talk-to-dossie-1005). Changes: Luna (Dossie) narrates in first person instead of Heath's clone; crop_y 452 lifts the answer bubble ~180px clear of the caption band; answer/hold zoom reduced so the bubble never drifts into it; captions band_width 780 (fixed-width opaque band drawn under every cue, so each caption reads as one solid band and the gate can find it) and max_words 2 (Luna's pace makes a 3-word cue ~1.3s, which the gate's 1s change-pair reads as frozen); clip b trimmed + paced so runtime stays inside TikTok's 21-34s. Clip a moved from 2.6s to 4.0s so it plays over the typing: that shortens the silent hold before clip b from 4.0s to 2.6s, and (simulated against the gate's own word-sampling) lifts captions_present from 3/5 to 4/5 changing pairs -- the remaining non-changing pair is unavoidable: '$647,000' / '$6,470' are single written tokens Luna takes ~2s to say, and no clip offset keeps all five samples off both of them.
